XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Airbag

  • Device: Instrument panel

  • Fault: Fuel gauge malfunction: when the engine is started, the needle makes a full anti-clockwise rotation, moves to the opposite end of the scale and then returns steadily to zero.
    At the same time, the low fuel warning light remains on. Furthermore, the odometer displays neither the total nor the trip mileage, despite the backlight being operational.

  • Faults detected by the self-diagnostic system: - -

  • Cause: Faulty instrument panel

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the instrument panel; if necessary, repair or replace it

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: In this case, the instrument panel showed no visible faults and, following its replacement, the problem was permanently resolved without the need for any reprogramming using diagnostic equipment.

    The estimated time for the service is approximately 1 hour.
